liturgicalName: The Ascension of the Lord (Thursday or 7th Sunday of Easter where transferred)
keyVerseDR: "...whilst he blessed them, he departed from them and was carried up to heaven." (Lk 24:51)

level1.title: Jesus Goes to Heaven
level1.story: Jesus told His friends, "Tell everyone about Me." He blessed them and was carried up into heaven. They went back to Jerusalem full of joy!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus do before He went up?
level1.prayer: Jesus, bless me from heaven. Amen.

activity.title: Alleluia!
activity.intro: Decorate the letters. Jesus went up to heaven!

level2.title: He Was Taken Up
level2.story: Jesus said to His disciples that the Christ must suffer and rise from the dead on the third day. He said repentance and forgiveness of sins should be preached in His name to all nations, and "you are witnesses of these things." He promised to send the promise of His Father upon them. Then He led them out to Bethany, lifted up His hands, and blessed them, and He was carried up to heaven. They adored Him and went back to Jerusalem with great joy, praising God in the temple.
level2.keyLine: Whilst he blessed them, he departed from them and was carried up to heaven.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why were they joyful, not sad?
How can you be Jesus' witness?
level2.prayer: Jesus, ascended Lord, make me Your witness. Amen.

activity.title: You are witnesses
activity.intro: Copy the verse. Highlight the word that touched you most.
activity.text: And you are witnesses of these things. And I send the promise of My Father upon you.

art.mainBrief: Jesus blessing as he rises; apostles joyful
